name: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a real estate company in Pudong New Area. The company develops, sells, operates, and leases real estate properties. Its property portfolio includes office, residential, business, exhibition, hotel, regional development, and charitable properties. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shanghai Lujiazui Development (Group) Company Limited.
